action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const clickX = rect.left + rect.width * 0.35; const clickY = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: clickX, clientY: clickY, bubbles: true}));

postconditions: Mask emissive intensity increases to indicate selection
Selected artifact index is set to 0

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const startX = rect.left + rect.width * 0.35; const startY = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: startX, clientY: startY, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: startX + 100, clientY: startY, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {clientX: startX + 100, clientY: startY, bubbles: true})); }, 200); }, 200);

postconditions: Mask rotation Y value has changed from initial position
Artifact has been rotated via mouse drag interaction
System is ready to place annotation tags on artifacts

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const clickX = rect.left + rect.width * 0.35; const clickY = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: clickX, clientY: clickY, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { const input = document.querySelector('input[type="text"]'); if (input) { input.value = 'Gilding technique'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); const confirmBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.match(/confirm|ok|add/i)); if (confirmBtn) confirmBtn.click(); } }, 500);

postconditions: At least one tag has been placed on the mask
Mask tag count is greater than zero
